purpose: The heading over one group of options inside the Combobox list, so related options read together.

notFor.case: Standalone use outside a Combobox list.
A heading inside a menu of actions.

notes: When composed by hand, put aria-labelledby on the group wrapper so screen readers announce it.

openQuestions: Colour: the contract binds no colour role for the group label's text. Which role paints it?
